senses.definition: n.[m.] Mikhtām, a term. techn. in ψ-titles, meaning unknown (𝔊 στηλογραφία: cf. Bae Ps. p. xiii f.); always c. לְדָוִד:—מ׳ לְדָוִד ψ 16:1; 60:1; לְדָוִד מ׳ 56:1; 57:1; 58:1; 59:1.
